content: ESA - Opportunities for media: ESA’s Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer Science & Exploration Opportunities for media: ESA’s Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer 20/12/2022 4775 views 41 likes ESA / Science & Exploration / Space Science / Juice In brief Media are invited to visit ESA’s Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer, Juice, at Airbus in Toulouse, France on 20 January 2023, prior to shipment to Europe’s Spaceport in French Guiana for its April launch on an Ariane 5. Media are also invited to express interest for pre-launch and launch day media activities at the Spaceport.
